LightningComponentBundle.description: Interactive Action Plan playbook checklist with progress, guidance, overdue highlighting and locked steps that are still waiting on a prerequisite.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Heading shown at the top of the component.

property.name: guidanceText
property.label: Guidance Text
property.description: Best practices shown in the collapsible guidance panel. Leave blank to use the Action Plan Template description.

property.name: expandGuidance
property.label: Expand Guidance By Default
property.description: Show the guidance panel open when the page loads.

property.name: emptyMessage
property.label: Empty State Message
property.description: Message shown when the action plan has no steps.
property.default: This action plan has no steps yet. Steps appear here once the plan is generated from its template.
